title: Play becomes a media playground
summary:
Play gained a full media playground, agents gained discovery catalogs, and PDFs became valid input for supported Claude and GPT models.

The Play page was replaced with a playground for image, video and audio generation, with uploads, previews, downloads, request-based API examples and shareable URLs that preserve supported settings through sign-in. Text mode was removed. The page was brought into the shared site layout alongside Home, Apps and Community updates; legacy image links also regained redirects so embeds receive images rather than website HTML.

Claude and GPT requests gained base64 PDF input, including GPT requests through the Responses API. Nova 2 Lite now accepts video parts instead of dropping them and rejects unsupported audio input. Model listings gained a `paid_only` field, the bare `tts` alias was corrected to use free OpenAI TTS, and Qwen3 VL was moved to a working route. Smaller CLI, media-error and transcription-doc changes make the edges less surprising.

Hosted MCP servers gained an AI catalog and public Server Cards describing how to connect. A separate RFC 9727 API catalog points agents to the OpenAPI specification and plain-text guide without requiring them to know those URLs first. The merged API docs sidebar was also regrouped around public paths.

daily.title: A new Play playground
daily.text: Generate images, video and audio in one place, with uploads, previews, downloads and API examples built from your request. Shareable URLs keep supported settings together. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: PDFs in chat requests
daily.text: Send base64 PDFs to supported Claude and GPT models, including GPT models using the Responses API. Chat `file` parts and `/v1/messages` PDF document blocks are supported. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Discover hosted MCP servers
daily.text: Agents can find hosted MCP servers through `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` and read public Server Cards for connection details. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Discover the API spec
daily.text: The new `/.well-known/api-catalog` gives agents a standard way to find the OpenAPI specification and plain-text guide. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Check model eligibility
daily.text: Entries from `/v1/models` and `/v1/models/{model}` now include `paid_only`, so OpenAI-compatible clients can tell which models require paid Pollen without another lookup. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
